params.signmessage:
You can run by double tapping Right or Left.
In the air you can press Down to Lunge or Dive forwards
Also, while on ducking/crouching on the ground, you can backflip off the ground by quickly pressing Up and back.

params.signmessage: Hover Fludd also can be used to regain balance if you slip off a Platform high in the air.  Also, if you run out of Water, but aren't anywhere near a River or Pool, you can refill your water by collecting a 'Water Bottle' like the one on that Mushroom over there.

You can take this Warp-Pipe to Princess Peaches Castle
(Get on top of it and press down to enter)
